name: bonobo-kong
north_star: Black Sands era Bonobo: every sound feels like a sample of a real instrument; layers ANSWER each other (call-and-response), never shout together
reference: Bonobo · Kong (F# minor/Dorian, 94 BPM, centroid ~1980 Hz, dyn 5.5x; arc intro-verse-chorus-solo-inst-solo-chorus-end)
caption: A warm, groovy neo-soul instrumental built on a foundation of a tight, funky drum break and a melodic, active bassline. A classic Rhodes-style electric piano lays down lush, jazzy chords, creating a soulful and relaxed atmosphere. Kalimba and vibraphone bell phrases answer each other in call and response over a slow stretched drone bed. The arrangement evolves with the introduction of a clean, melodic line that weaves through the chord progression, enhancing the track's rich, layered, dusty feel-good vibe.
caption_note: edited from acestep-captioner prose on Kong (datasets/handpicked/bonobo-03-kong.acecaption.txt) — the captioner's native dialect calls this 'neo-soul'; kept the bells/drone/call-response north star
script:
[Intro - lone kalimba phrase over drone]
[Verse - upright bass and soft drums join]
[Chorus - layered bloom, bells answer]
[Instrumental - horn melody takes the lead]
[Breakdown - drone bed, sparse bells]
[Chorus - full bloom returns]
[Outro - layers peel away to the drone]
